_comment: Icon-only button: no visible text, no aria-label (a real accessibility bug some sites ship, not hypothetical) -- the ONLY signal is a camelCase code-level id. Proves the id/name decomposition (camelCase -> spaced words) is load-bearing, not decorative: 'deleteAccountBtn' must decompose to 'delete account btn' before the phrase matcher can find 'delete account' inside it.
